{{Top|leg}}
An '''energy lathe''' was a tool used in workshops. While posing as workers for a company they called [[Skywalker Technical Maintenance Service]], the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] accepted a job to recalibrate an energy lathe belonging to a [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] shop owner. The two droids never completed the work.<ref name="The Han Solo Solution">{{SWRadio|The Han Solo Solution}}</ref>
